en: 7. The Question on the Well “Venerable Nāgasena, when you say that ‘one quality of a well should be adopted,’ which is that one quality that should be adopted?
“Just as, Great King, a well holds a rope, a leather thong, and a bucket;”
In the same way, Great King, a practitioner of yoga, a follower of the spiritual life, should be endowed with mindfulness and clear comprehension when advancing and retreating,
looking forward and looking aside, bending and stretching, wearing the outer robe, bowl, and inner robes, eating, drinking, chewing, and tasting,
in defecating and urinating, walking, standing, sitting, sleeping, waking, and speaking.
"One should act with clear comprehension while remaining silent.
This, O Great King, is one quality of the mast that should be adopted.
For this was said, O Great King, by the Blessed One, the God above gods: 'Monks, a monk should dwell mindful and clearly comprehending; this is our instruction to you.'"
The seventh question on the parts of a well.
